definitions.ask: Should the smoke derive its core version from sase 0.18.0's own core floor instead of hard-coding it?

choices.label: lowest-direct resolve, assert core equals sase's floor; survives the core-window ratchet
Hard-code sase-core-rs==0.40.0; explicit, but stale if sase ratchets before 0.18.0 ships

definitions.why: sase owns the core window and has already ratcheted it from 0.34.71 to 0.40.0

definitions.ask: Should the coder close bug bead sase-1ei once the fix lands?

choices.label: Close as done; publish then waits only on sase 0.18.0 (sase-1kx) plus a release-PR merge
Leave it ready with a progress note until a 0.3.x release reaches PyPI

definitions.why: the defect it names is fixed; the remaining wait is already tracked by sase-1kx
